prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String deadlineSequence(String input)
Behavior: Parse start;delay,delay where start and every delay are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000 and at least one delay is required. Add delays cumulatively with a maximum timestamp of 10000000. Return each resulting timestamp joined by commas; reject overflow or malformed input.
Visible example: 10;5,0,7 returns 15,15,22.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String deadlineSequence(String s){try{String[]p=s.split(";",-1);if(p.length!=2||p[1].isEmpty()||!p[0].matches("0|[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;long n=Long.parseLong(p[0]);if(n>10000000)return null;var o=new ArrayList<String>();for(String x:p[1].split(",",-1)){if(!x.matches("0|[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;n=Math.addExact(n,Long.parseLong(x));if(n>10000000)return null;o.add(""+n);}return String.join(",",o);}catch(Exception e){return null;}}}
